top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the five enrolled children's admission information was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walkthrough, an infant was observed sleeping with a bib on.     Note: The bib was removed immediately

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching mickey mouse during snack time    This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver turn off the tablet and closed it.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
